# Speech triggers

## Speech finished

Runs when Cuebot has finished reading a text out loud, or when it was skipped. Good for hiding a talking avatar again.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Voice alias** | The name of a voice (a "voice alias" from the Speech page). Empty means any voice. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%text%` | The text that was read |
| `%alias%` | The voice name that was used |
| `%user%` | The viewer whose message was read (empty for your own speech) |
| `%duration%` | How long the speech took, in milliseconds |
| `%skipped%` | True if it was skipped and not read |

<small>Type id: `speech.finished`</small>

## Speech started

Runs when Cuebot starts reading a text out loud with its text-to-speech voice. Good for lighting up a talking avatar or showing who is being read.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Voice alias** | The name of a voice (a "voice alias" from the Speech page). Empty means any voice. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%text%` | The text being read |
| `%alias%` | The voice name being used |
| `%user%` | The viewer whose message is being read (empty for your own speech) |
| `%source%` | Where the text came from, like chat or an action |

<small>Type id: `speech.started`</small>

## Speech state changed

Runs when speech is switched on or off, paused or resumed, or a VoiceGate profile changes. Good for showing a "speech paused" light on your stream.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%enabled%` | True if speech is switched on |
| `%paused%` | True if the speech queue is paused |
| `%eventsEnabled%` | True if event speech (reading follows, subs and so on) is on |

<small>Type id: `speech.stateChanged`</small>
